IIT Bombay Professor's Suspension Sparks Protests and Support

Professor Suryanarayan Doolla of IIT Bombay has been suspended, leading to protests and expressions of support from students and other IITs. Students at IIT Bombay organized a rally expressing anger over the suspension. Faculty from IIT Delhi and IIT Madras have also voiced their support for Professor Doolla, stating reasons for their backing. One report frames the situation as highlighting systemic flaws following a student's suicide at IIT Bombay, questioning the effectiveness of measures like removing ceiling fans as solutions to prevent suicides.
